name: Advanced CAD for Creative Design in Automotive Domain
description: This course will introduce the creative design process in the automotive industry to design four and two wheelers. This course will introduce one polygonal modelling as well as NURBS modelling to ideate, improve, create, and visualize concepts in 3D to integrate it with the design process. This course will introduce and start students in polygonal modelling software like blender and alias for NURBS. The students will work on a project brief to put the learning in practice.
